# GOOD

> GOOD is a digital media platform dedicated to publishing inspiring human-interest stories, viral moments, and feel-good content that celebrate culture, innovation, and everyday heroes.

GOOD curates uplifting narratives across culture, society, health, and lifestyle, featuring stories from everyday people making a difference and viral moments that restore faith in humanity. The platform leverages social media distribution across Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube to amplify positive storytelling.

## Key Topics

- human-interest stories
- viral video
- feel-good content
- culture and society
- teacher perspective
- trending news
- lifestyle advice
- health and wellness
- technology and innovation
- social media
- daily newsletter
- TikTok
- YouTube
- Facebook
- company mission

## Core Pages

- [GOOD - Homepage](https://www.good.is): Homepage featuring inspiring content on planet, culture, innovation, health, politics, and more.
- [About Us](https://www.good.is/about-us): Company information about GOOD, its mission, history, and leadership.
- [All Posts](https://www.good.is/all-posts): Archive page aggregating all human-interest, viral, and inspiring stories published.

- [A bride collapsed during her own rehearsal dinner toast. The detective who burst in explained everything.](https://www.good.is/pn-bride-murder-mystery-rehearsal-dinner-fairmont-banff): Bride stages murder mystery prank at Fairmont Banff rehearsal dinner for guests.

Then a nurse looked closer and spotted something that led to a devastating diagnosis.](https://www.good.is/pn-alice-leukemia-diagnosis-nurse-mom-pinprick-bruises-xray): Nurse mother's observation of pinprick bruises leads to daughter's leukemia diagnosis.
